name: Huellitas Mágicas
source: Hikari is shy and lacks self-esteem. One day, she gets assigned the worst kind of job for her: being the organizer of the camping trip. But she finds 3 magical cards that grant wishes. Will she be able to overcome her fears and open to others? Who are the beings inside these cards? Maybe with them, she can find out something a bit more than friendship...
translation: Hikari性格害羞，也缺乏自信。一天，她被指派负责自己最不擅长的工作：组织露营旅行。但她发现了三张能够实现愿望的魔法卡牌。她能否克服恐惧，向他人敞开心扉？卡牌中究竟住着什么？也许那些存在能帮她找到超越友情的情感……
